description:
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
CH 776594
SUPERIOR
COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F01376822
U.S. BANK NATIONAL ASSOCIATION,
AS TRUSTEE OF THE IGLOO SERIES
IV TRUST is the Plaintiff, and KELLIE
A. TARSIA, ET ALS., are Defendants,
writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged premises dated 06/18/2024.
By virtue of the above stated Writ, to me
directed and delivered, I will expose to
sale at public vendue on WEDNESDAY,
the 9TH DAY of ?????ER, A.D. 2024, at
the hour of one thirty by the then prevailing (Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at the
Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Ave, New
Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located in the
TOWNSHIP OF WOODBRIDGE, in the
County of Middlesex, and State of New
Jersey.
Commonly known as: 48 MORNINGSIDE ROAD, COLONIA, NJ 07067;
Tax LOT: 13, Tax BLOCK: 506-B
Dimensions of Lot: (APPROX.) 150 X 65
Nearest Cross Street: LANCASTER
ROAD
Important:
Indicate Lien information, if any, to be
advertised pursuant to the Supreme Court
decision of 10/28/99 - Summit Bank vs.
Dennis Thiel (A-58-98).
Good Faith Estimated Upset Price:
$573,675.70
Occupancy Status: Owner Occupied
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES
THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE
WITHOUT FURTHER
THROUGH PUBLICATION
NOTICE
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and
satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains
any surplus money, the money will be
deposited into the Superior Court Trust
Fund and any person claiming the
surplus, or any part thereof, may file a
motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that
person's claim and asking for an order
directing payment of the surplus money.
The Sheriff or other person conducting the
sale will have information regarding the
surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the upset to
be satisfied by said sale is the sum of
FIVE HUNDRED SEVEN THOUSAND
FIVE HUNDRED FIFTY EIGHT AND
48/100 ($507,558.48) dollars more or less,
plus interest together with the costs of this
sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE
SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF
ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or restrictions upon the exercise of such power as
may be specially provided by law or rules
of the Court. Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of bid in a certified check or
official bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
FRIEDMAN VARTOLO LLP
85 BROAD STREET, SUITE 501
NEW YORK, NY 10004
Attorneys
